summary: Acquittal by High Court reversed; eye-witness testimony consistent and credible despite minor discrepancies; identification of accused Satendra and Neetu upheld; same-village basis not sufficient to reject dacoity; FIR and postmortem evidence corroborated; lack of ballistic match and non-recovery of cartridges explained by incomplete recovery; non-chargesheeting of Neetu overcome under CrPC s.319; investigation flaws noted but not fatal; conviction restored.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned High Court judgment quashed; conviction and sentence restored as per trial court.
